understanding: A control-plane refactor of the self-hosting Bridge driver loop. The 'action-evidence DONE-guard' currently lives in driver/85-loop-mode-transitions.ps1 (~lines 12-95): it computes action evidence (Get-TaskActionEvidence + Test-TaskCoveredVerifiedDoneEvidence) and writes $s.task_did_actions. That write happens on the CODER turn ($speaker -eq 'codex'), BEFORE status is parsed in 86. The consuming done-gate is in driver/86-loop-completion-checks.ps1 at ~line 1438 (the DONE∧normal cluster): it reads (Read-State).task_did_actions and, if didActions but no [[VERIFIED]], forces the coder back (force_coder). Status-parse is ~1023-1036. Under the newly-enforced StrictMode (per recent commit on blocks 83/85/86), evaluating the guard before status/decision variables exist throws 'property/variable not found' ~6x/session, and evaluating evidence at the wrong phase produces spurious 'DONE отклонён'/force_coder right after an accepted DONE. The fix relocates the guard into 86 immediately after status-parse (after ~:1027) and before the done-gate (before ~:1433), so all referenced variables are populated and the evidence reflects the decision actually being gated. Because this edits the loop that runs the agent, it must ship via bridge_self_canary + operator authorization + driver.ps1 -SelfTest + smoke.ps1 + rollback notes.
summary: Relocate ONLY the action-evidence→task_did_actions computation (not the whole 85:12-95 block, which also contains the unrelated PARALLEL handler and no-progress/Activate-Doctor detector) into 86 between status-parse and the normal-DONE done-gate. Treat it as a redesign, not a cut-paste, because the source is codex-guarded while the gate is claude/fastLaneDone-guarded — recompute evidence from durable git/state signals at the gate phase. Validate first in shadow/observe-only mode (reusing the existing depth-shadow / delivery-gate-shadow pattern), then cut over only after a canary in an isolated worktree shows both target metrics at 0, SelfTest+smoke green, and the operator authorizes. Rollback = single-commit revert.

decision_atoms.statement: Root cause is StrictMode-triggered references in the 85 guard to status/decision state that only exists after status-parse in 86; relocating after status-parse (~:1036) resolves the 6 'property/variable not found' throws.
decision_atoms.reason: A recent commit enforces Set-StrictMode -Version Latest on dot-sourced blocks 83/85/86; under strict mode, reading a not-yet-populated variable/property throws, and the guard currently runs before status-parse.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Inferred from the StrictMode commit and execution order rather than a captured stack trace; the exact 6 references should be confirmed from session logs before claiming the metric is fully addressed.

decision_atoms.statement: This is NOT a pure cut-paste: the source block is guarded by ($speaker -eq 'codex'), but the done-gate fires on (($speaker -eq 'claude') -or $fastLaneDone). The relocated evidence must be recomputed from durable, speaker-agnostic signals (git diff vs base commit via Get-TaskActionEvidence, and state), NOT from the current turn's reply.
decision_atoms.reason: Get-TaskActionEvidence reads repo/git ground truth (speaker-independent), whereas Test-TaskCoveredVerifiedDoneEvidence -Reply reads the reply; naively running codex-guarded logic at the claude-phase would evaluate the wrong reply and break the cross-turn task_did_actions contract.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Recomputing at the gate adds one git evidence read per DONE turn (minor latency) but removes the cross-turn coupling that causes the spurious force_coder.

decision_atoms.statement: Preserve the existing state contract: keep $s.task_did_actions as the durable carrier the done-gate consumes (Read-State.task_did_actions at ~:1439), so covered-after-restart and other consumers keep working.
decision_atoms.reason: The done-gate and Test-CoveredAfterRestart already key off task_did_actions; changing the carrier would widen blast radius beyond this task.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Stays within the proven state model but means the relocation must still write/read the same flag, not introduce a new variable.

decision_atoms.statement: Scope the move precisely to the action-evidence/DONE portion (~85:67-84); leave the PARALLEL handler (~13-49) and the stagnation/no-progress + Activate-Doctor detector (~51-101) in place in 85.
decision_atoms.reason: Lines 12-95 of 85 bundle three concerns; the no-progress detector and PARALLEL dispatch are unrelated to the DONE-gate and have their own side effects (no_progress_count, Activate-Doctor).
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Requires surgical extraction and careful dependency tracing rather than moving a contiguous block, but avoids dragging unrelated control flow into the done-gate cluster.

decision_atoms.statement: Ship behind an observe-only / shadow stage before live cutover, reusing the existing shadow pattern (depth-shadow.jsonl / lib/delivery-gate-shadow.ps1).
decision_atoms.reason: Shadow logging the new-location decision alongside the old for K sessions proves the two target metrics reach 0 without risking the live loop; the infra already exists in-repo.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Delays the cutover by several sessions of evidence collection but is the cheapest insurance for a self-modifying control-plane change.

decision_atoms.statement: Gate the cutover through bridge_self_canary in an isolated git worktree, with driver.ps1 -SelfTest + smoke.ps1 as merge prerequisites, an explicit operator authorization step, and a single-commit revert as rollback.
decision_atoms.reason: Editing 85/86 edits the loop currently executing the agent; canary infra (lib/canary.ps1, tools/test-autopilot-controlplane-gate.ps1, test-canary-* tools) exists exactly for this class of change.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Higher process overhead per change, but a broken done-gate could deadlock or infinitely force_coder the whole autopilot — the overhead is justified.

decision_atoms.statement: Anchor the insertion on semantic markers (the planner status-parse regex block and the `plannerStatus -eq 'DONE' -and modeBeforeIncrement -eq 'normal'` gate), not on the literal line numbers :1027/:1433.
decision_atoms.reason: The contract's line numbers are a snapshot; 86 is large and actively edited, so raw offsets drift and risk pasting into the wrong cluster.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Slightly more work to locate the anchors at edit time, but removes the most likely silent-failure mode (correct file, wrong position).

decision_atoms.statement: Add a deterministic regression test (e.g. tools/test-driver-done-guard-relocation.ps1) asserting (a) no StrictMode throw across the 86 done path and (b) no force_coder/CONTINUE flip on the turn after an accepted normal DONE, and wire it into the control-plane gate.
decision_atoms.reason: The success criteria are metric-based (×6→0, spurious→0); a unit/regression test converts them into a repeatable gate rather than relying solely on live session observation.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Test authoring effort up front, but it is the only durable guard against regression on a control-plane edit.

assumptions: Set-StrictMode -Version Latest is active for dot-sourced blocks 85/86 (implied by the recent test-driver-loop-strictmode commit), so undefined variable/property access throws.
Get-TaskActionEvidence/Get-TaskActionEvidenceContext read git/state ground truth and are speaker-agnostic; Test-TaskCoveredVerifiedDoneEvidence reads the reply text.
The done-gate referenced as ':1433' is the normal-DONE gate at ~:1438 that reads task_did_actions and can flip plannerStatus to CONTINUE (the 'force_coder' mechanism).
The contract's line numbers (12-95, :1027, :1433) are approximate snapshots and will drift; semantic anchors are authoritative.
bridge_self_canary is the in-repo canary mechanism (lib/canary.ps1 / canary.ps1) and tools/test-autopilot-controlplane-gate.ps1 is the control-plane gate it integrates with.
'Operator authorization' means a human approval step that must precede live cutover, separate from the autonomous backlog approval.
The shadow/observe-only pattern (depth-shadow.jsonl, delivery-gate-shadow) can be reused to dual-run the old vs new decision without affecting live flow.
The action-evidence guard is only one of three concerns colocated in 85:12-95; the PARALLEL handler and no-progress detector are out of scope and stay put.

risks.risk: Wrong ordering relative to the done-gate — the relocated guard ends up after the gate has already decided, making it a no-op and leaving both metrics unchanged (the contract's truncated 'неверный порядок относительно done-...' risk).
risks.mitigation: Insert strictly between the status-parse block and the normal-DONE gate, anchored on semantic markers; add the regression test asserting decision order and run it in the control-plane gate.

risks.risk: Speaker-context mismatch: codex-guarded evidence logic moved to the claude/fastLaneDone phase evaluates the wrong reply/turn, introducing NEW spurious DONE rejections instead of removing them.
risks.mitigation: Recompute evidence from durable git/state signals at the gate; keep $s.task_did_actions as the carrier; shadow-compare old vs new decisions for K sessions before cutover.

risks.risk: Self-modifying control-plane edit bricks the driver loop (deadlock or infinite force_coder), and because the loop runs the agent, recovery is hard.
risks.mitigation: Canary in an isolated worktree; driver.ps1 -SelfTest + smoke.ps1 as merge prerequisites; operator authorization gate; single-commit revert documented and pre-staged as rollback.

risks.risk: Over-broad extraction: moving the whole 85:12-95 block drags the PARALLEL handler and no-progress/Activate-Doctor detector into the done cluster, corrupting unrelated control flow.
risks.mitigation: Surgically extract only the action-evidence→task_did_actions lines; trace all consumers of the moved code (no_progress_count, Activate-Doctor) and confirm they remain in 85.

risks.risk: Line-number drift: 86 is large and actively edited, so :1027/:1433 no longer point where the contract assumes, causing a paste into the wrong cluster that passes review by line number.
risks.mitigation: Locate anchors by code pattern (status-parse regex, the DONE∧normal gate condition) at edit time; verify the surrounding cluster before committing.

risks.risk: Metric verification is hard to prove to 0 from a short canary window — the errors are intermittent (×6/session), so a clean canary may be luck rather than a fix.
risks.mitigation: Require both the deterministic regression test (proving no StrictMode throw / no spurious flip) AND a multi-session shadow window showing 0 occurrences before declaring success.

minimal_version: Surgically extract the action-evidence/DONE portion (~85:67-84) and place a recomputed, speaker-agnostic evidence evaluation in 86 between the planner status-parse (~:1036) and the normal-DONE gate (~:1438), still writing/reading $s.task_did_actions so the gate logic is unchanged. Leave the PARALLEL handler and no-progress detector in 85. Confirm no StrictMode throws on the done path, then run driver.ps1 -SelfTest and smoke.ps1, capture their output as canary evidence, get operator authorization, and document a one-commit `git revert` as rollback. Anchor edits on code patterns, not raw line numbers.
advanced_version: Land the relocation behind an observe-only shadow stage first: the new-location guard logs its DONE decision to depth-shadow.jsonl alongside the still-live old-location decision (reusing the delivery-gate-shadow pattern) for K sessions, with a small comparator asserting old≡new and counting StrictMode-throw and spurious-force_coder occurrences. Add tools/test-driver-done-guard-relocation.ps1 asserting (a) zero 'property/variable not found' on the 86 done path and (b) zero CONTINUE/force_coder flip on the turn after an accepted normal DONE, and wire it into tools/test-autopilot-controlplane-gate.ps1. Then cut over via bridge_self_canary in an isolated worktree with automatic rollback if either target metric is non-zero, gated on SelfTest+smoke green and explicit operator sign-off. Rollback notes cover both the single-commit revert and the shadow-flag kill-switch so the change can be disabled without a redeploy.
